text:
Aria: Tiny shoutout — Rina jumped in during the 11:45 deploy hiccup and rolled back the canary in like 7 mins. Saved the partner demo. :raised_hands:
Derek: absolute hero. Rina stayed until the logs made sense. :clap:
Hannah: also shoutout to Ben for sprinting to the kitchen with energy bars. Fuel matters. :battery:
ops-bot: incident logged: canary-deploy-failure | resolved by Rina | rollback performed | no customer impact. :white_check_mark:
Rina: teamwork — Derek's quick rerun + Hannah's runbook pointer made it a clean rollback.
Vik: idea: "Sprinkle Stickers" + coin jar for snack fund. Small kudos, small treats. Thoughts?
Aria: love it. low-effort, high-signal.
Derek: poll: :card_index: handwritten notes or :label: stickers? react to vote.
Hannah: :label: stickers. fast and silly. Can we make 3 designs? "Saved the Deploy", "Demo Saver", "Snack Hero"
Ben: volunteering to print 60 stickers this afternoon. Also I'll chip in for the coin jar.
Rina: if we're doing stickers, can we have a tiny date and initials spot? makes them feel personal.
Vik: good call. Also thinking of a small "micro-kudos" column on the whiteboard where people stick them next to names.
Aria: I'll add the micro-kudos column before standup tomorrow. Also adding a 1-line note to Friday digest: "micro-win: Rina rolled back canary, prevented partner-facing issue"
Derek: GIF suggestion for the digest: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheer-teamwork-26BRuo6sLetdllPAQ
Ben: I'll bring a jar of mints labeled "Kudos Coins". Please put stickers on the board when you take one.
Hannah: tiny follow-up: Rina, want a coffee voucher from the Snack Fund? :coffee:
Rina: lol yes please. thanks everyone  this made my morning.
Aria: quick logistics: sticker designs in #design and final print run at 3pm. Volunteers to stick: Derek + Ben?
Derek: in.
Ben: in. See you at 3. :tada:
